text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: EVAL_GATE_TRIGGERED - Safety/eval regression detected for routing group `prod-text-gen`
incident-bot: Model: redwood-3b-quant v2.3, Eval suite: safety_v1, Failure rate jumped to 8.7% (threshold 2.0%)
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PAGER-58321 created and paged oncall

pagerduty: PAGER-58321 - Page sent to @oncall-jordan (urgent)

oncall-jordan: ack - I got the page, looking now :eyes:
oncall-jordan: quick question, is this affecting live traffic or only canary?
ml-eval: traffic routing shows canary at 5% and baseline at 95%. Eval failures coming from canary only so far (95% of failing samples from canary).
oncall-jordan: ok, escalate if baseline also fails. For now let's fail-open the canary routing and switch traffic to stable variant.
eng-kevin: I can flip routing. Planning to move canary -> 0% and route 100% to `redwood-3b-quant-v2` stable. ETA 2m.
product-ops: @oncall-jordan please confirm we'll do a hot rollback and notify CS if customer sessions could see degraded outputs.
cs-maya: We just got one customer note in inbox about hallucinations. Could be related. I'll prepare a proactive message if we confirm impact.
oncall-jordan: go ahead @eng-kevin, put canary to 0 and pin stable model. After that run a quick smoke eval on 200 random samples.
eng-kevin: running: `redwood-route set --group prod-text-gen --variant canary --weight 0`
eng-kevin: response: OK - propagation started (k8s roll triggered)
incident-bot: Route change detected: canary weight 5 -> 0. Stable variant `redwood-3b-quant-v2` now at 100% (propagation ~40s)
ml-eval: starting quick smoke eval (200 samples) against stable: `python tools/eval/smoke.py --suite=safety_v1 --samples=200 --model=redwood-3b-quant-v2`
ml-eval: smoke eval complete: failure rate 1.6% (within threshold). Canary remains problematic, no baseline regression detected.
oncall-jordan: good. That's a mitigation. I'm going to acknowledge the pager and start an incident record.
oncall-jordan: ack PAGER-58321 :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PAGER-58321 status -> acknowledged by oncall-jordan
product-ops: Can we tag impacted customers and queue a short notification? @cs-maya take lead on messaging. Keep tone: "we observed potential unsafe outputs from a canary model; we routed you to stable; no broad impact detected."
cs-maya: will draft now. Also flagging account ACME corp who filed the ticket.
sre-alyssa: quick ask — add a temporary alert to mute further canary eval gate pages until followup investigation completes. We don't want noisy repeats while team triages.
oncall-jordan: good call. @incident-bot, silence eval_gate pager for routing group `prod-text-gen` for 2h.
incident-bot: Command accepted: silence `eval_gate` alerts for `prod-text-gen` for 2h.
eng-kevin: created a rollback PR to pin canary variant off the rollout config for next deploy: `github.com/redwood/inference/rollouts#PR-##`
ml-eval: creating ticket for root cause triage: failure mode looks like recent tokenizer patch caused safety classifier mismatch for edge prompts. Filing with labels: `sev2`, `eval-regression`, `tokenizer`
noncall-jordan: assigning follow-ups:
- eng-kevin: write up routing/rollback steps and link PR
- ml-eval: full eval across recent prompt corpus and reproduce failure set
- product-ops + cs-maya: customer comms draft and Postmortem liaison
- sre-alyssa: ensure alert tuning and silence window documented

oncall-jordan: incident public status: "Mitigated - traffic reverted to stable variant; smoke eval passes. Postmortem & root cause in progress." I'll update the incident channel and create a short status page note.
product-ops: thanks all. If anything changes, ping @here and escalate.
cs-maya: draft ready, sending to legal & product for review, will post after approval.
ml-eval: leaving note: dataset of failing prompts saved to S3: `s3://redwood-eval/failures/PAGER-58321/`
noncall-jordan: closing pager hands off to follow-up owners. If any regression reoccurs, page oncall.
incident-bot: PAGER-58321 -> resolved (status: mitigated).
noncall-jordan: closing thread here. Follow-ups are tracked in task tracker: `https://tracker.redwood.ai/ISSUE-4521`
eng-kevin: adding a short post-deploy test to catch this specific failure case in future canary rollouts.
ml-eval: thanks everyone. :pray:
